info.title: 11 Estates CRM — crm-engine (matching) API
info.description: Service S4 (HLD §2). Pairs demand with supply many-to-many, ranks pairs, builds bundles, records date-aware exclusions, flags and feedback, and owns the weights. PII-free by design: its projection holds no names, phones, emails, building names or unit details. Conventions: docs/04-lld/conventions.md. LLD: docs/04-lld/crm-engine.md.

servers.description: Vercel project `crm-engine` (bom1). Reached only via web (staff), pg_cron (internal) or service tokens.

post.description: Suggested → Confirmed. 409 invalid-match-status for Rejected/Closed. Records feedback (M6).

post.summary: Reject a match with a reason code (US-21)
post.description: Suggested or Confirmed → Rejected (a confirmed match can be withdrawn before a deal opens; 409 match-in-deal otherwise). The pair is not re-suggested unless its score rises by ≥ rejectedResuggestMinGain after an offer fact change.
post.x-rate-limit: 20/s per user, burst 40 (token bucket at web)
post.x-idempotency: Idempotency-Key (UUID, 24 h, per user+route); replay returns the original status and body; rejecting an already Rejected match returns 200 unchanged

post.summary: Build a bundle of 2–3 offers for a demand (A-38)
post.description: Validates the bundle rules; failures return 400 with errors[] (bundle-too-large, bundle-segment-not-allowed, bundle-not-colocated, bundle-mixed-deal-type, bundle-hard-filter-failed, bundle-area-insufficient; LLD §6). Same offer set for the demand → returns the existing bundle (200).

get.description: Callers: journeys, listings, insight (serviceToken aud=crm-engine). Sorted by (updatedAt, id).

post.summary: Relay unpublished outbox rows into consumer pgmq queues
post.description: Invoked every minute by Supabase pg_cron + pg_net and poked after commits. Claims up to 500 outbox rows (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, ordered by occurred_at), sends one copy per subscribed consumer queue (subscriptions from contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml) and sets published_at. Timeout 10 s: batch work, not on a user request path.
post.x-idempotency: safe to re-run: work is claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; events deduped on eventId
post.x-timeout-reason: batch relay of ≤500 outbox rows; internal, not a user request (R-5)

post.summary: Drain a pgmq queue owned by this service
post.description: Reads up to 100 messages (visibility timeout 60 s), dedupes on eventId via processed_events, applies each in its own transaction, deletes on success. After 5 failed reads a message moves to <queue>_dlq (alarm on depth > 0). Timeout 55 s: stays under the Hobby function limit; remaining messages are picked up by the next minute's call.
post.x-idempotency: safe to re-run: work is claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; events deduped on eventId
post.x-timeout-reason: consumer batch under the function limit; internal, not a user request (R-5)

post.summary: Run a scheduled job (one bounded batch; continues on the next call)
post.description:
Jobs:
- `full-rescore` (03:00 IST daily (after journeys' 02:00 life-curve run) and after PUT /v1/weights): re-score every live demand against its candidates in keyset batches; emits re-ranks, flags and closes
- `micromarket-refresh` (on micromarkets.updated.v1 / vocabulary.released.v1 and 01:30 IST daily): reload the micromarket hierarchy and adjacency list from records (GET /v1/micromarkets, serviceToken issued by web, R-2/R-13) and recompute mm_path / mm_expanded
- `projection-reconcile` (Sunday 04:00 IST): compare projection versions with records/journeys rebuild APIs and repair gaps

Each call processes batches until a 50 s budget is used, records a cursor in job_runs and returns `done=false` if work remains; pg_cron calls again the next minute until `done=true`.
post.x-idempotency: safe to re-run: work is claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; events deduped on eventId

x-schedules.full-rescore: 03:00 IST daily (after journeys' 02:00 life-curve run) and after PUT /v1/weights
x-schedules.micromarket-refresh: on micromarkets.updated.v1 / vocabulary.released.v1 and 01:30 IST daily

post.x-timeout-reason: bounded job batch (50 s budget) with continuation; internal (R-5)

staffViaWeb.description: Service token minted by web for a signed-in staff user (aud=<service>, sub=web, tid, 5 min), plus headers X-User-Id, X-User-Role, X-Tenant-Id. Services re-check role and tenant.

serviceToken.description: Service-to-service JWT (aud=<service>, sub=<caller>, tid, 5 min). Issued by web at POST /internal/v1/service-tokens; verify with web GET /.well-known/jwks.json (conventions R-2). Internal routes only.

cronSecret.name: X-Cron-Secret
cronSecret.description: Per-service secret used by Supabase pg_cron/pg_net for /internal/v1/relay, /internal/v1/drain/*, /internal/v1/jobs/*.

rank.description: Rank among the demand's open suggestions (1 = best)

Match.description: A ranked pairing of one Demand with one Offer or a bundle (≤3) of Offers. PII-free.

Explanation.description: Why this match exists: every hard filter checked, every factor with weight and points (US-28 'score and factor breakdown', R-CHAT-2).

ConfirmRequest.description: Empty body. Free-text notes are not accepted (crm-engine is PII-free).

confirm.description: Confirm immediately (Demand agent, Manager, Admin only)

BundleCreate.description: Manual bundle (C-10 'Build bundle'). 2–3 offers, Commercial or Industrial demand, same building or same/adjacent micromarket, each offer must pass the demand's hard filters except area (A-38).

priceOverBudgetZeroPct.description: Price factor falls linearly to 0 at this % over budget max

Weights.description: Match scoring weights and tunables (PRD §4.5, M6). Factor weights are normalised by the sum of applicable factors.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID; 24 h replay window per user+route. Same key with a different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Row version for optimistic concurrency; mismatch → 412 version-mismatch.
